notes.title: Update 1.5.0 : The Endless Update
notes.content:
[h1] Hello I hope you enjoy the game !
If you do, please [u]leave a review [/u]it really (really) helps the development ! ❤️ [/h1]

[h2] - New game mode : Endless [/h2]

The Endless game mode is the perfect mode if you seek a little challenge like me, you start with one epic point per wave. With the epic points, you can buy upgrades to get items, chests, machines or more epic points !
Taking a damage = you lose 3 epic points (might change that if I see that it's too tough)
It really gets crazy once you hit the 100th wave, trust me! Good luck !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270022/187c28b0190f171212d8df2d7b4334f90babdd4f.gif[/img]

[h2] - 2 New Characters "Peargus" and "Adam" [/h2]

Peargus is a cute character that goes berserk when killing enough enemies !
Peargus's skill makes him go berserk on command.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270022/82a65e14a83cb8fa94eb4d3289cd054086da37ae.gif[/img]

Adam is a psychopath that has a mechanical arm, great for close range weapons and shooting behing cover !
Adam's skill makes every enemy explode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270022/22a6af91eeffd5e9393abea9c6ccd8d126b55280.gif[/img]

[h2] - 2 New Weapons "Lychee" and "Bananyah~" [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270022/9efffffde9068e46a4b5d3054d17dea70abea240.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270022/8815b5072ac2824a71b96f186b73d8a990b0f075.gif[/img]

[h2] - 2 Character Rework "Rainier" and "Zitrus" [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270022/4e669c81e3a47165fa0ba510e1d7096d0bd27a0a.gif[/img]

[h2] - New OSTs ! [/h2]

The OSTs will be on all streaming platforms soon !

[h2] - And much more ! [/h2]

- 12 New Steam Achievements
- Desert alt biome (Badlands)
- UI and HUD Redesign
- New machine (Quizzz)
- Heavy optimizations
- Lots of Balancing

If you want to report a bug, give feedback or ask questions, [url=https://discord.gg/2jyB9w2DZE]you can join the discord here[/url] !

notes.title: Update 1.4.0 : The Community Update
notes.content:
[h1] Hello i hope you enjoy the game !
If you do, please [u]leave a review [/u]it really (really) helps the development ! ❤️ [/h1]


[h2] - New Challenging character "Modified Berry" [/h2]
He starts with 0 speed and force you to use the grappling hook extensively. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270022/b1c47a6d5617596529bf500a36511defa84767f5.gif[/img]

His skill has a 50% chance to turn the closest item into a "Genome Guardian" (the new item)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270022/1928e0fe3be542d4ae7a299054c6cdcdaab98553.gif[/img]

[h2] - New "Genome Guardian" item [/h2]
This item is a direct reference to the game "Genome Guardian" by Alpherior
We made a bundle together, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49346/_Genome_Guardian_x_Fruity_Rogue__Roguelike_Shooters/]you can find it here[/url] !
The item is an orbital that provide a different shot effect depending on the letter. (cycles through the ACGT letters when hit)

[h3] A - Machine gun [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270022/744836449bc1c8bee4d71a53bd1648be87e44799.gif[/img]

[h3] C - Pistol [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270022/8ef894168b8fa657375c1ff09c35df60c5cd81e0.gif[/img]

[h3] G - Shotgun [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270022/18da8bfe6622c6f18e06fa0211d3567f8e7949bc.gif[/img]

[h3] T - Bomb [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270022/8e6b8ec878e4c25940a58518e3ad631adb38ce72.gif[/img]

[h2] - Seeded Runs [/h2]
You can now share your run's seed with friends and the community.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270022/efe58b7af46b7cecead556cb5c0e7ae578f5b714.gif[/img]

[h2] - Run Timer [/h2]
The timer allows you to speedrun without ever using any third-app software.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270022/5bcc12ebf571f072013acd8fe6494c425eec1bc7.gif[/img]

[h2] - (Beta) Controller Support [/h2]

If you find any issues and bugs, please report them to the discord server.
I added controller support, but it may be unstable since i only tested with a ps4 controller.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270022/812f69d785ea78932b861c1d8f65626483387fd7.gif[/img]

[h2] - Leaderboard [/h2]

You can now compete in the global leaderboard, to see which is the fastest. Each entry to the leaderboards comes with additional infos like the Character and Weapon used, or the seed of the run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270022/ab08052df986c8970ea12a81dcf3013a9e500b2a.png[/img]

Thank you for playing, and if you want to be a part of the development (vote the next feature, etc..) [url=https://discord.gg/2jyB9w2DZE]Don't hesitate to join the discord here[/url] !
